title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the Playbooks view, edit, execute, and delete…
description: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain a vulnerability where users with roles granting Playbooks view, edit, execute, and delete permissions can cause cross-repository playbook references to execute attacker-controlled code. This occurs because the system allows binding of existing cross-repository playbook references to a different source control repository if a deleted repository name is reused.
